package.name: armold_can_driver
package.description: Protocol driver for thingsbyjosh CANBUS Stepper nodes (Armold arm joints J0-J5 + gripper AUX PWM). Encodes/decodes the vendor CAN protocol (11-bit ID = NodeID<<6 | MsgType, little-endian payloads) and owns the joint-space to motor-space gear/unit mapping.
